rules.condition: at a rising i_clk_core edge when HSEL, HREADY and HTRANS[1] are all 1
rules.statement: The bridge accepts a transfer at a rising i_clk_core edge when HSEL, HREADY and HTRANS[1] are all 1.
Address/control are taken from the address phase; HWDATA/HWSTRB belong to the corresponding data phase.
BUSY and IDLE transfers must not create AXI traffic.
Supported HSIZE encodings are byte, halfword and word (0,1,2), and transfer addresses shall be naturally aligned to HSIZE.

rules.condition: HSIZE>2, misaligned access, reserved HBURST, or unsupported/reserved HPROT memory type
rules.statement: The bridge returns AHB ERROR with no AXI request for the rejected transfer; any earlier accepted write prefix is drained.
AHB SINGLE and undefined INCR are converted to AXI single-beat INCR transactions.
Each read beat of fixed INCR/WRAP bursts issues its own single-beat AR request.
AXI write burst aggregation is limited to complete legal Normal Write-back fixed write bursts with constant AXI address attributes.
Device writes must never be merged into an AXI burst.
Captured but unissued write beats are drained as ordered AXI singles without reissuing sent beats; no short AXI burst replaces the AHB burst.
AHB managers must not start an incrementing burst that crosses a 1 KiB boundary.
The bridge keeps every AXI burst within a 4 KiB boundary, splitting defensively for out-of-profile address sequences.
HPROT remains constant throughout an AHB burst.

rules.condition: burst-scoped AXI address attribute differs between accepted beats
rules.statement: The bridge uses ordered AXI singles instead of a burst.
The bridge issues no exclusive requests; HMASTLOCK=1 is rejected with AHB ERROR.

rules.condition: VALID asserted and READY not yet handshaken
rules.statement: AXI4 VALID and payload remain stable until READY handshakes; AXI outputs have no combinational dependency on READY.
At most one read and one write transaction may be outstanding.
Reads are single-beat: ARLEN=0, ARBURST=INCR, RLAST=1.
Writes are single-beat or fixed bursts up to 16 beats.
AXI ID is 3 bits; each direction rotates through IDs 0..count-1 after each completed transaction.
ID count greater than 1 does not enable concurrent transactions.

rules.condition: R or B response not returned
rules.statement: The related AHB operation remains pending indefinitely.
The transfer is rejected with AHB ERROR before any AXI request is issued.
AxPROT[0]=HPROT[1], AxPROT[1]=HNONSEC, AxPROT[2]=~HPROT[0].
AxCACHE[1]=HPROT[3], AxCACHE[0]=HPROT[2]; HPROT[4]=0 gives AxCACHE[3:2]=00; HPROT[4]=1 sets direction-specific allocate bits per HPROT[5].
Issue one AXI single per beat, never merge, and wait for final-destination BRESP.
Writes are single-beat with no burst aggregation.

rules.condition: Write-back eligible bufferable fixed burst with constant AXI address attributes
rules.statement: The bridge may aggregate such bursts into an AXI burst.
One accepted address returns one AXI R beat; no speculative or multi-beat read; AHB waits for R and maps RRESP.
One AHB beat maps to one AXI single with no undefined-length aggregation; wait for BRESP.
A full 4/8/16-beat burst uses one AXI burst only with uniform attributes; prior beats get early OKAY and terminal HRESP reflects final B status.
No AXI request for the rejected transfer; two-cycle AHB ERROR; drain any previously accepted write prefix.
Non-OKAY maps to AHB ERROR.
